_doc: What Ash can eat and where (food_data.gd, food_menu.gd, meal.gd). items.<id>: name, desc (short and tasty), kcal (fills kcal / tunables/hunger.json kcal_per_pct %), minutes (game minutes it takes to eat; the moment's bites), model (food/dishes.gd), utensil (fork | spoon | chopsticks | cup | hand), hot (steam; a warm one: the 'warm' condition), effect (optional: sugar_rush | warm | refresh, with stamina: how much of the bar it gives back), tags (shown as chips). meals: the hours of breakfast, lunch and supper (supper runs past midnight to breakfast). places.<id>: name, sub (a line under it), host (who serves: the speaker in lines), host_id (a person in people.json), voice, accent (the menu's colour), pay: free | tab (the price goes on Ash's tab there, paid 'when you're a famous trainer'), categories [{id, name, items: [{id, price, when: [meals]}]}], lines: what the host says when Ash orders (order), as he finishes (done; by meal for home), and when Ash asks for the menu in a talk (menu). Ash has no money of his own yet: Mom's cooking is free, the inn and the tea house keep a tab.

pancakes.name: Mom's fluffy pancakes
pancakes.desc: A tall stack, golden and soft, with melting butter, berry syrup running down the sides and fresh oran berries.

breakfast_set.name: Rice, miso and tamagoyaki
breakfast_set.desc: A proper Pallet breakfast: fluffy rice, miso soup with tofu and scallion, and sweet rolled omelette.

cocoa.name: Hot cocoa
cocoa.desc: Rich and chocolatey, with marshmallows bobbing on top and a cookie on the side.

onigiri.name: Onigiri plate
onigiri.desc: Two rice balls wrapped in crisp nori, one with a sour plum, one with sesame. Pickles on the side.

curry.name: Curry rice
curry.desc: Glossy, mild-and-sweet curry with soft potato, carrot and beef over a mountain of rice.

hamburg.name: Hamburg steak
hamburg.desc: A juicy hand-made patty in shiny demi-glace, with buttery carrots, broccoli and mash.

cream_stew.name: Cream stew
cream_stew.desc: Chicken and vegetables simmered in a smooth, milky stew, with a crusty roll to dunk.

seafood_stew.name: Pallet seafood stew
seafood_stew.desc: The house special: shrimp, clams and mussels from the morning boats in a bright tomato broth.

omurice.name: Omurice
omurice.desc: Ketchup rice tucked inside a soft, buttery omelette, with a zigzag of ketchup on top.

pecha_tart.name: Pecha berry tart
pecha_tart.desc: Crisp pastry, pink pecha cream and a crown of glazed pecha slices and berries.

lemonade.name: Fresh lemonade
lemonade.desc: Squeezed this morning, ice-cold, with a slice of lemon and a sprig of mint.

green_tea.name: Green tea
green_tea.desc: Hana's own sencha with spring water. A tea stalk is standing up in it: good luck!

matcha.name: Whisked matcha
matcha.desc: Bright, frothy matcha whisked to a fine foam, served with a little flower sweet.

dango.name: Hanami dango
dango.desc: Chewy pink, white and green rice dumplings on skewers. Sweet, soft and a bit springy.

daifuku.name: Strawberry daifuku
daifuku.desc: Pillowy mochi around sweet red bean, one with a whole strawberry peeking out.

taiyaki.name: Taiyaki
taiyaki.desc: Crispy fish-shaped cakes, hot from the iron, filled to the tail with red bean.

breakfast: Good morning, sleepyhead! Sit down, breakfast is nearly ready.
lunch: Lunch already? Coming right up, sweetie.
supper: Wash your hands, supper's on the table!

breakfast: Every bite? Good boy. Now you've got the energy for a big day.
A trainer runs on a good breakfast, Ash. Remember that out there.
lunch: There. Now you won't be grumbling at Professor Oak all afternoon.
Full? Good. Don't run straight after, you'll get a stitch!
supper: Clean plate! Your father had an appetite like that, you know.
Mmm, I'm glad you liked it. There's always more where that came from.
treat: A little treat never hurt anyone. Just don't tell Professor Oak.

menu: Hungry? Let's see what I can make you.

_any: One {item}, coming right up! For my favourite customer.
Good choice, honey. Find a seat, I'll bring it out.
How was it? Honestly, now. I'm trying a new recipe for the guests.
I've put it on your tab, sweetie. You can pay me back when you're a famous trainer.

menu: For you? Always! Here's today's menu, sweetie.
Of course, honey. Take a seat, have a look.

_any: Sit down, sit down. One {item} for the young traveller.
Ah, a fine choice. The kettle's already singing.
There now. Rested legs and a full belly: Viridian isn't so far after all.
Don't worry about paying, dear. I'll write it in my little book. Pay me when you're a famous trainer!

menu: Of course, dear. Here, have a look at what's on today.
Sit, sit. A traveller needs feeding. Here's what I have.
